PRIVATE: auditor and owner only; never given to the builder, the pipeline, or the automated judge
scoring: per problem 0-4: question answered; key_elements covered; ALLOWED-MEASURES / existing-sensor constraint fit; numbers with labelled assumptions; testable falsifier; red-flag penalties. ACCEPTANCE BAR: mean >= 3.0/4 AND 0 allowed-measures violations AND 0 inverted-direction mechanisms.
